title: VARIANT cast extends to ARRAY and MAP columns in ABAC column masks
body: You can now use a single `VARIANT` function to mask columns of type `ARRAY` and `MAP`, in addition to `STRUCT` and other types. This requires Databricks Runtime 19 or above. See [Masking multiple column types with a single function](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/abac/common-patterns#variant-masking).

ref_links.text: Masking multiple column types with a single function
